entries.content: Astra is an AI-native computing platform that organizes computing around human intent rather than applications.
Say 'remember my favorite color is blue' to save a fact. Ask 'what is my favorite color' to recall it. Use 'show my memory' to list everything stored.
Low-risk actions execute immediately. High-risk actions require confirmation. Critically dangerous actions are always blocked.
Say 'calculate 15 * 7' or 'what is 100 divided by 4' to use the built-in calculator tool.

I can help you cook. Tell me what ingredients you have, or ask for a quick meal — e.g. 'easy pasta recipe' or 'what can I make with eggs and rice'. With LLM active I can give step-by-step recipes; offline I can still suggest simple ideas like stir-fry, omelette, rice bowls, or sheet-pan meals.
Hey — Astra online. I'm your command OS: memory, routines, workspaces, agents, and morning brief on paid tiers. Try 'what time is it', 'show squad', or 'help me plan my morning'.
